title: Andrographis paniculata tincture for medicinal use
intro: Andrographis paniculata tincture is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the Andrographis paniculata plant, commonly known as the "Indian echinacea." This tincture is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine and modern herbalism for its potent immune-boosting properties. It is often employed to support the body's natural defenses, particularly during cold and flu seasons. The active compounds, such as andrographolides, are believed to have anti-inflammatory and antiviral effects. It is typically taken in small doses, either directly or diluted in water, to help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and enhance overall wellness.
